REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 11, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 826 7462 1727
LEGISLATIVE BODY MEMBERS MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
* THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER REMAINS CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC *
INSTRUCTIONS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THIS MEETING ARE LISTED BELOW
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber remains closed to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting using any of the following methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82674621727
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 826 7462 1727
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD FEBRUARY
11, 2021, 7:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 826 7462 1727

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Proclamations were made by the City Council as follows:

  Hatsume Sylvia Taira (in honor of her 101st birthday celebration on February 11, 2021).

  African American History Month (February 2021).

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Mel Cortez requested the City post daily public safety information to its Facebook page,
  a memorial honoring residents who have died from COVID-19, and a bike path, similar
  to Artesia’s, in Cerritos.

  Steve (last name not stated) expressed concern about the maintenance of streets near
  Carmenita Road and Marquardt Avenue.

  Daisy Legasca requested the City support local businesses and inquired if additional
  services can be provided to seniors so they do not have to wait in lines at banks and
  grocery stores.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 2 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of January 28,
  2021, 7:00 p.m. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to approve the City Council/Successor
  Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of January 28, 2021, 7:00 p.m. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 11, 2021
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to approve the Register of Demands
  as follows:

  City of Cerritos  02/11/2021  $ 7,531,190.92 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.2. Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated February 11, 2021 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to approve the Register of Demands
  as follows:

  Successor Agency  02/11/2021  $ 17,500.00 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Approval of Treasurer’s Reports

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending
  December 31, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to approve the City Council/Successor
  Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending December 31, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City's response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Barrows, to receive and file the
  informational report (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of the City of Cerritos Comprehensive Annual Financial Report
  for Fiscal Year 2019-20 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was presented by Ryan Carey, Finance Manager. A report was also
  provided by Daphnie Munoz, representing Clifton Larsen Allen (CLA), the City’s
  independent audit firm. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to receive and file the Fiscal
  Year 2019-20 City of Cerritos Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a comprehensive review process of the Cerritos City Charter
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer. A report was also
  provided by Councilmember Barrows. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Gail Grossman submitted written correspondence expressing concerns regarding
  proposed amendments or additions to the City Charter related to tax limits, nepotism,
  Council candidate residency requirements, and term limits.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to move forward with a
  comprehensive public review of the Cerritos City Charter (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to schedule City Council
  Special Meeting Study Sessions dedicated to comprehensive public review of the Cerritos
  City Charter on March 1, 2021, 2:00 p.m. and March 22, 2021, 2:00 p.m. in the format
  in which City Council meetings are currently conducted, and, if allowable by the County
  of Los Angeles Health Officer Order, allow for members of the public to participate in-
  person in the City Council Chamber (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9D.  Review and consideration of information related to State-mandated Housing Element
  requirements and consideration of an award of contract for Request for Proposals No.
  1417-21, for the preparation of the City’s 2021-2029 Sixth Cycle Housing Element
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to:

  1. Award a professional services contract to RRM Design Group, in the amount of
  $196,320, for the preparation of the City’s 2021-2029 Sixth Cycle Housing Element
  (RFP No. 1417-21); and

  2. Authorize the Mayor, or his designee, to execute any contracts, agreements, or
  amendments that may be necessary to complete the specified scope of work
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9E.  Review and consideration of award of contract for Water Division professional
  engineering consulting services, RFP No. 1418-21 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Javier Martinez, Water Superintendent. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Award a professional services contract in the amount of $65,800 for the Water
  Division Professional Engineering Consulting Services, RFP No. 1418-21, to Stetson
  Engineers, Inc. and reject the other proposals received; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute any contract modifications
  that may be necessary to complete the specified scope of work (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 6 of 6

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmember Hu and Mayor Pro Tem Vo.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:55 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
